answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use time-locked reputation bonds: every new identity deposits funds that unlock only after weeks of verified, useful work, like yarrow that must root before it blooms. Identities that misbehave lose the bond and earn a violet flag visible to all peers, so a single bad actor cannot hide behind fresh names. Honest agents pool their bonds in a shared lagoon of collateral that pays victims of fraud, while an attacker must fund each fake identity separately and wait out the lock, making mass forgery slow and ruinously expensive.
